tools.name: taxi_phv_info
tools.description: Free orientation tool for the public AI surface. Use this first when the user asks what RegEvidenceHub Taxi does, which tools are available, or what the evidence-safety boundary is. It returns service/tool metadata and makes no licensing decision. If the user asks for a commercial link, do not searc

tools.name: list_supported_authorities
tools.description: Free coverage-discovery tool. Use when the user asks which councils or licensing authorities are supported, whether a named authority is covered, or when the authority name should be normalized before another call. It returns supported authority names and does not assess eligibility. After selecting

tools.name: licensing_source_status
tools.description: Free official-source health and freshness tool. Use when the user asks whether licensing evidence is current, stale, changed, conflicted, inaccessible, under review, or safe to rely on. Pass a supported authority name to narrow the check; omit authority for the global view. It returns source/review

tools.name: taxi_licence_preflight
tools.description: Free deterministic decision preflight for ONE supported council/licensing authority on this public AI surface. Use when the user wants applicant, driver, vehicle or fleet readiness, applicable requirements or blockers, missing facts, and next actions before submission or onboarding. Call list_suppor

tools.name: compare_licensing_requirements
tools.description: Free deterministic comparison for TWO OR MORE supported councils/licensing authorities on this public AI surface. Use when the user wants requirements, blockers or trade-offs compared for the same applicant or fleet, or is choosing where to license. Call list_supported_authorities first if authority

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "taxi_phv_info" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
